Products.title: Career Path Planner ebook
Products.description: A 100-page PDF from Class 10 to your first profession — streams, exams, thirty careers, and write-in worksheets. Compiled and published by Smruti Ranjan Sahoo.

Products.title: All Career Paths
Products.description: A PDF directory of every profession in the AgamiPatha app — 124 careers across 26 fields, with routes in, exams, pay bands, and sample institutes. Compiled and published by Smruti Ranjan Sahoo.

Products.title: 99 Cost-Effective Recipes for Bachelors
Products.description: A PDF cookbook of 99 cheap one-pan Indian recipes — breakfast, lunch, snacks and dinner — with colour photos for each section. Pair it with First-year College Survival for hostel weeks. Compiled and published by Smruti Ranjan Sahoo.

Products.title: Class 10 Stream Chooser
Products.description: A 64-page write-in workbook for the Class 10 stream decision — PCM, PCB, PCMB, Commerce, Arts, and vocational doors, what each opens and closes, parent conversation scripts, and four-week experiments. Compiled and published by Smruti Ranjan Sahoo.

Products.title: First-year College Survival
Products.description: A 56-page campus workbook: hostel, attendance, internals, how to read a syllabus, and when to change course. Pairs with 99 Cost-Effective Recipes for Bachelors. Compiled and published by Smruti Ranjan Sahoo.
